pr_body: Reject premature ready_for_validation actions until the immutable proposal's planned mutations have successful governed evidence, while still permitting explicit validation-only and playtest-only runs. Strengthen the model prompt so inspection/progress cannot be mistaken for implementation completion. Also preserve NotApplicable source-validation truth in AI Studio status text instead of labeling it as passed. Adds regression tests for code/MCP mutation evidence, empty execution proposals, and NotApplicable wording. Logic-only AI Studio behavior change; no layout or visual styling changes.
